title: Right And Wrong
paragraphs: “Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Hahaha! Too weak! You’re all far too weak!”
“K-Kitamura-dono! Calm down a little—uwaaaaah!?”

And so, I headed deep into the mountains, where ferocious monsters roamed—a place I had already devastated in my previous loop. During the battle, Éclair clung to me, wailing the entire time. It only took a few hours, but Éclair’s level increased quite a bit. Originally, I had wanted to continue fighting through the night, but I needed to return to teach Father and the others about weapon enhancements, so I came back. When we arrived, Éclair was completely drained, sitting at the entrance of the room, utterly exhausted.
“I’ve burned out… turned completely white…”
Father waved his hand in front of Éclair’s pale face a few times and muttered something. She was so unresponsive that she didn’t even react to him.
“Naofumi-san, I’m sure this is some kind of parody, but considering that could be us in a few days, maybe you shouldn’t joke about it.”
“Y-Yeah, you’re right.”
“Honestly, I feel like I’ll end up hearing about what happened later, but… I really don’t want to know.”
Ren looked at Éclair with pity, as if gazing upon someone truly unfortunate.
Did I really do something that strange? I was just leveling her up normally.
“I believe this is the same training Father had Filo-tan do when he was raising his party members in the original world.”
“What the hell did future me even do?!”
Father’s face was frozen in shock.
Curious, are we? I was fully prepared to recount the glorious feats of Father’s past.
“What exactly did you do to make Eclair completely burn out like this?”
“For now, wouldn’t it be better to prioritize hearing more about the future from Motoyasu-san?”
“You’re right. Given what lies ahead, this is information we absolutely need.”
“Yeah. In a world like this, where we have actual stats, staying at single-digit levels is pretty bad.”
“Recruiting allies is also risky for now. Our best bet is to gather intel from Motoyasu.”
“In the future, Ren and Itsuki both convinced themselves this world functioned exactly like their games.”
Now that’s some progress, isn’t it?
Although… it seems I won’t get to tell the tales of Father’s glory. I could have talked about them all night, but oh well.
“Well… I can’t deny that it’s a possibility. If my game knowledge proves useful in practice, that would be enough to convince me.”
Ren crossed his arms and nodded several times.
“In fact, last night, I was already in the middle of testing that theory in battle.”
“I was doing the same, but I got confused when I wasn’t earning any experience points.”
“As for me… well, I was listening to the conversation, but I hadn’t reached the point of putting it into practice yet.”

Father and the others listened to me in a friendly and engaged manner. This is a good sign. If they believe me, the battles ahead will become significantly easier, and we can prevent the incidents that occurred in previous loops before they even happen.
“Now then, let’s start with the enhancement methods.”
At my words, Father and the others nodded.
“First, let’s talk about the enhancement methods that Ren and Itsuki know about. Technically, I should be included in that as well, shouldn’t I?”
“Yeah.”
“Right. So, what exactly are the enhancement methods we know of?”
“As long as you have the right materials and conditions, you should be able to use the enhancement methods you’re familiar with.”
“Well… I can’t really argue with that. I’ve tested it myself.”
“But… there’s more to it, isn’t there?”
“It’s both correct and incorrect at the same time.”
Ren and Itsuki tilted their heads in confusion at my response.
“In the original world, we were able to use it. But in all the other loops, we couldn’t… What was the reason?”
“Do we need to experience some kind of major setback first?”
“I was able to do it, right? So isn’t that the difference?”

Father and the others were deep in thought. If I explained everything all at once, it would just confuse them, and believing it is an important process. Even in the previous loops, Father had to take some time to fully grasp how to use it.
“So, Motoyasu, what’s the answer?”
“It was because the Heroes were at odds with each other.”
“Hmm…”
“Ah, I think I get it now.”
“Me too.”
Itsuki and Father raised their hands, indicating they understood. Ren, however, was still tilting his head in confusion.

“I played a gal game like this before. I think it was a survival-type one. In it, players had different abilities and rules, but to properly use them, they had to exchange information with each other. If you unknowingly broke a rule, you’d get eliminated from the game.”
“I’ve read a novel like that before. If that’s the case, then maybe our enhancement methods are actually something we can share.”
“I see… So that’s why it’s both correct and incorrect.”
Ren also nodded in understanding.
“That is correct. Ren, Itsuki, and I can share our enhancement methods, and by doing so, we can become several times stronger.”
“So it was like skipping the tutorial in a game just because it felt familiar, only to hit a dead end later?”
“Ah… yeah, I get that. There are times when you don’t realize you’re missing important information until much later.”
“Like when a game prioritizes agility, so you assume it’s useful based on similar games, only to find out it’s actually a useless stat.”
“Yeah, that happens. When a long-running game series changes its system significantly, it’s easy to make mistakes.”

Father and the others nodded in agreement. As expected, they’re gamers at heart. The “strike while the iron is hot” strategy is working well. Whether it’ll ultimately succeed is still a gamble, though.
“However, in order to share this enhancement method, you have to truly believe in what the other person is saying, from the bottom of your heart.”
At my words, Ren and Itsuki swallowed hard.

“I see. If we viewed the other Heroes as rivals to be outmaneuvered, and on top of that, believed Naofumi was a rapist, all while thinking we had been transported into a world that matched our ideal game settings, then there’s no way we would have ever believed this was possible.”
“Yeah, I get that. Even now, I still feel somewhat skeptical, even after seeing how strong Motoyasu is.”
“Then doesn’t that mean Ren won’t be able to use it?”
“I’ll just have to try. I don’t know if belief is something I can force myself to have, though.”
“I’m surprised Naofumi was able to believe in it under those conditions.”
“Actually, maybe it was precisely because of those conditions that he was able to believe.”
“What do you mean?”
“Think about it. In that situation, he had nothing left to lose, and on top of that, he didn’t even have an enhancement method of his own.”
“I-I see… so it was precisely because he had nothing that he was able to trust it…”
Father and the others started developing their own theories. Even without me explaining further, they were arriving at the truth on their own.

Why couldn’t they have grown this much by the time we arrived at Cal Mira Island? Looking back now, it’s a mystery. But it’s all because of that damn pig. That bastard is already gone from this world, so I just hope things continue to go in a better direction.
“Of course, the fact that some enhancement methods are shared is, in a way, a trap.”
“You mean Drop and Weapon Copy?”
“Wait, there’s something like that?”
“Two days ago, we just assumed you already knew about it since it’s listed in the help menu, so we talked about hunting grounds under that assumption.”
“Ugh… the real problem is that it’s listed so blatantly in the help menu. As for the other enhancement methods… if they only appear once they’re shared, then that’s going to be a huge pain.”
“So some of it is correct while the rest is wrong… what a nasty trap.”
“From what Motoyasu is saying, it sounds like we acted purely based on our game knowledge and ended up causing a major disaster. So there are probably more issues beyond just this.”
“So, should we proceed under the assumption that Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu’s enhancement methods can be shared?”
“That would be best. Right now, we don’t have the necessary materials for enhancement, and we haven’t fully equipped ourselves, so we can’t test it yet. But I want you to remember this.”
Father and the others nodded several times.
“By the way, when it comes to things to teach Itsuki, we haven’t found a weapon with the skill to understand otherworldly scripts yet.”
“I don’t know why you’re specifically directing that at me, but…”
